citations.assessment: The Bavli distinctly gives Mari son of Pinḥas son of Ḥisda, and makes an anonymous man carry the donkey and come before Rav Ashi.

notes.text: The Bavli distinctly gives Mari son of Pinḥas son of Ḥisda, and makes an anonymous man carry the donkey and come before Rav Ashi.
Heilprin compresses the case. The named Mari is the donkey owner in the cited text; the anonymous man is the overt participant in the later action.
